summary: Iteration 109: Reporting Module APIs and Sidebar UX Redesign fully tested. All 21 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed. New features: Planner Performance Leaderboard, Category Health Scorecard, ROI Dashboard, User Profile Dropdown with avatar/role badge, Sidebar footer with Online status and Ctrl+B shortcut.

TEST_09_category_structure.notes: Each category has stock_health, fill_rate, doh, revenue_30d

TEST_13_kpis_structure.notes: KPIs has total_plans, approved_plans, plan_approval_rate, time_saved_hrs

TEST_15_monthly_revenue_structure.notes: Each entry has month (YYYY-MM), revenue, qty, transactions

TEST_18_ranks_sequential.notes: Leaderboard ranks are sequential starting from 1

TEST_F23_category_cards.notes: Category cards with stock health, fill rate, DOH metrics

critical_code_review_comments: Planner Performance API correctly aggregates buy_plans and buy_planning_approval_audit collections
Category Health API uses style prefix extraction (STYLE-TS-001-WHT-L -> STYLE-TS-001) to map SKUs to categories
ROI Dashboard API calculates time_saved_hrs as total_plans * 1.92 (estimated manual vs automated time)
User Profile dropdown uses data-testid='user-profile-toggle' and 'user-profile-dropdown' for testing
Role badge uses ROLE_COLORS and ROLE_LABELS maps for consistent styling
Sidebar footer shows 'Online' status with green pulse indicator and Ctrl+B keyboard shortcut
All 5 INSIGHTS nav items correctly displayed: Readiness, Forecast Accuracy, Planner Performance, Category Health, ROI
Module system correctly hides AI Demand Planning when ai_insights module is disabled
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data in merch_production database (28 buy_plans, 185813 daily_sales)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 109 verified the Reporting Module with 3 new dashboards: (1) Planner Performance Leaderboard at /planner-performance showing 1 planner (admin@demo.com) with 28 plans, 32.1% approval rate, (2) Category Health Scorecard at /category-health showing 3 categories (Apparel, Footwear, Accessories) with 100% stock health and fill rate, (3) ROI Dashboard at /roi showing 53.6% plan approval rate, 53.8 hrs time saved, 28 plans generated. The sidebar UX redesign includes: UserProfileSection component with avatar (initials), role badge (Super Admin in purple), and dropdown menu (Profile Settings, Security & MFA, API Keys, Switch Tenant, Sign Out). The sidebar footer shows 'Online' status indicator and 'Ctrl+B' keyboard shortcut. The INSIGHTS section now has 5 items.
